newsitem.title: USA: Ginnie Mae increases REMIC 1997-2 to $400 mln.
newsitem.headline: Ginnie Mae increases REMIC 1997-2 to $400 mln.

text.p: The Government National Mortgage Association (Ginnie Mae or GNMA) said it doubled the size of a prior issue of Real Estate Mortgage Investment Conduit (REMIC) securities to about $400 million.

REMIC 1997-2, backed by 7.5 percent GNMA II certificates, priced on January 6. The original size of about $200 million was increased on January 10, Ginnie Mae said. It has a settlement date of February 28, the agency said.
The issue is sponsored by Merrill Lynch & Co and co-sponsored by Utendahl Capital Partners LP, Ginnie Mae said.
